ContractScribe campaign

Usage:
  contract-scribe campaign start --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --configuration <path>
  contract-scribe campaign resume --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --configuration <path>

Options:
  --repository-root <path>  Existing repository root.
  --input <path>            Existing .sln, .slnx, or .csproj inside the repository.
  --policy <path>           Existing M1 policy file inside the repository.
  --snapshot <binding>      Caller-attested immutable snapshot binding.
  --state <path>            Campaign checkpoint outside the repository.
  --configuration <path>    Strict non-secret campaign configuration JSON.
  -h, --help                Print this help.

Environment:
  CONTRACTSCRIBE_PROVIDER_API_KEY  Selected transport credential; never persisted or emitted.

Exit codes:
  0  Campaign complete or no work.
  2  Invalid command-line usage.
  3  Bounded resumable stop.
  4  Invalid configuration, state, lease, revision, or snapshot.
  5  Terminal execution or checkpoint-publication failure.
  6  Cancelled.
  7  Timeout.
